Analysis workflow
=================

SpPrAn converts object-level spatial proteomics measurements into annotated
single-cell data, marker-defined phenotypes, spatial visualizations, and
population summaries.

Input tables contain individual segmented objects/cells and marker-positivity
measurements exported from Visiopharm®. SpPrAn creates per-sample AnnData
objects, assigns primary phenotypes and hierarchical subtypes, generates
selected spatial visualizations, and reports counts and percentages.
